blocks.html:
Students enrolled at the Università della Svizzera italiana who meet specific requirements may apply for a scholarship.

To facilitate your search, you can use the available filters to view the scholarships for which you are eligible.

How to correctly indicate your place of origin:

  • Canton of Ticino: select this option if you are a student from Ticino or an international student who is fiscally resident in Ticino.
  • Switzerland: select this option if you are a Swiss citizen or an international student who is fiscally resident in Switzerland.
  • Other origins: select this option if your origin is different from the above options.

Please note:

  • Applicants are invited to consult the individual calls for applications in order to verify all eligibility requirements and participation conditions.
  • Some scholarships take into account the fiscal residence at the time of obtaining the qualification granting access to university studies (secondary school diploma or equivalent qualification).
